execution_note: Kết quả PASS/FAIL chỉ hợp lệ khi lấy từ artifact của final exact SHA trên m1; file nguồn này không tự chứng nhận QA/BE2/DBA.

test_cases.scenario: Create SKU with valid component and physical code
test_cases.expected: 201; products, component, code, audit and idempotency snapshot commit together

test_cases.scenario: Retry exact SKU create with same key and canonical payload
test_cases.expected: Exact response replay; no duplicate rows or audit; Idempotent-Replay=true

test_cases.scenario: Reuse same key with changed SKU payload
test_cases.expected: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR; no business side effect

test_cases.scenario: Create direct self reference
test_cases.expected: 422 SKU_COMPONENT_SELF_REFERENCE; full rollback

test_cases.scenario: Create transitive cycle A->B->C->A
test_cases.expected: 422 SKU_COMPONENT_CYCLE; edge, version and audit unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate component or quantity <= 0
test_cases.expected: 422; no duplicate or invalid row

test_cases.scenario: Two concurrent SKUs assign one physical code
test_cases.expected: One commits; loser 409 ownership/unique conflict; no double ownership

test_cases.scenario: Two updates use the same SKU version
test_cases.expected: One commits and increments once; loser 409 SKU_VERSION_CONFLICT

test_cases.scenario: Force audit write failure under fail-closed policy
test_cases.expected: 500 canonical error; business/audit/outbox/idempotency all roll back; no stack trace

test_cases.scenario: Create container with valid bulk item
test_cases.expected: Root, items, audit and snapshot commit together

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate item_key in create payload
test_cases.expected: 422 DUPLICATE_CONTAINER_ITEM; root, item and audit absent

test_cases.scenario: Two containers claim one active serial concurrently
test_cases.expected: One commits; loser 409 serial ownership/unique conflict

test_cases.scenario: Containerize non-containerizable serial
test_cases.expected: 409 SERIAL_NOT_CONTAINERIZABLE; no mutation

test_cases.scenario: Container and serial or parent use different warehouses
test_cases.expected: 422 warehouse mismatch; no mutation

test_cases.scenario: Create self-parent or transitive parent cycle
test_cases.expected: 422; hierarchy unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Seal empty container
test_cases.expected: 422 EMPTY_CONTAINER_CANNOT_SEAL

test_cases.scenario: Update items, location or parent after SEALED
test_cases.expected: 409 CONTAINER_IMMUTABLE; no row changes

test_cases.scenario: Two updates use the same container version
test_cases.expected: One commits; loser 409 CONTAINER_VERSION_CONFLICT

test_cases.scenario: Missing permission or unauthenticated
test_cases.expected: 403 or 401; no business/audit side effect

test_cases.scenario: Trigger validation, business conflict and forced internal failure
test_cases.expected: Canonical envelope with request_id; no secret, SQL, file path or stack trace

test_cases.scenario: File contains duplicate, invalid enum/boolean and inactive SKU
test_cases.expected: 422; committed=false; inserted_rows=0; updated_rows=0; DB/audit unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Legacy duplicate serial claim exists before hardening
test_cases.expected: Preflight BLOCKED with violation count; deployment cannot proceed

test_cases.scenario: Read SKU/container after successful mutation
test_cases.expected: Nested components/physical_codes/items and version are returned consistently

test_cases.scenario: Legacy POST /v1/skus without Idempotency-Key
test_cases.expected: 201 remains supported; new mutations keep strict idempotency/version rules

test_cases.scenario: Verify every artifact and the manifest itself
test_cases.expected: sha256sum --check passes for SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sha256
